The '''Executive Privacy Suite''' was a forgery tool produced by [[Goseia Heavy Industries Concern/Legends|Goseia Heavy Industries Concern]]. It allowed users to create convincing counterfeit credentials in situations ranging from a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] misplacing an identity card to an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] needing temporary access to restricted areas. Equipped with high-quality inks, precision tools, and advanced falsification technology, the suite enhanced the natural skills of any [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forger]], whether their intentions were legitimate or covert.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Executive Privacy Suite was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
